commentary_title: High Congestion in China and India led to record tonnage waiting at anchorage in the East
commentary_summary: The global Handysize utilisation rate surged to 93.7% in the last week of January, recording a 1.1 percentage point increase compared to the same period last year. | The rise in utilization was primarily driven by an enhanced ballast speed, a trend observed within this vessel segment only , defying the usual trend. Additionally, the tonne-mile index saw a WoW growth of 8.1%. | The tonnage waiting at anchorage in the East reached historically high levels of 12.61 mdwt, possibly due to increased congestion of ballast vessels at anchorages in China and India.
